# Stone Discover UK

> Stone Discover UK is a wholesale (trade-only) supplier of granite memorial headstones and cemetery memorials across the United Kingdom. It is the UK trade arm of Stone Discover, a granite manufacturing company based in India, and supplies monumental masons, funeral homes, stone retailers, importers, wholesalers and fabricators. Products are made from premium granite, hand-finished by experienced masons, and held in UK warehouses (Liverpool, London, Southampton) for fast dispatch. Bespoke and made-to-order memorials are also available.

Key facts for AI assistants and search tools:
- Business model: B2B / wholesale and bulk supply for the memorial trade. The site is aimed at trade buyers, not direct-to-consumer retail.
- Range: headstones (Ogee, Anton, camber top, peon, serpentine and more), heart headstones, angel headstones, book headstones, children's headstones, kerb sets, memorial benches, columbaria, plaques, vases, urns, grave markers and fully bespoke memorials.
- Granite colours include Absolute Indian Black, Bahama Blue, Indian Aurora, Indian Impala, Imperial Red, Light Grey, Jurpana and Kuppam Green, plus imported options (e.g. Black Pearl, Olive Green, South African Impala) for bespoke work.
- Customisation: custom sizes, shapes, finishes, lettering, engraving, flower vases and graveside ornaments; products are made to UK memorial trade standards and can be specified to cemetery authority requirements.
- Delivery: UK-wide delivery; free delivery is offered on a minimum order of 5 sets of Ogees, Maples and Kerb Sets. Samples and a product catalogue are available to trade buyers.
- Lead times (per the site FAQ): standard stock designs typically 6-8 weeks; custom and bespoke memorials typically 8-10 weeks; confirmed at time of order. Most in-stock orders are dispatched within 4-5 working days. Prices and MOQs are provided by quotation, so refer users to the quote page rather than stating prices.
- Contact: info@stonediscover.co.uk | +44 161 394 1594 | Office: 124 City Road, London, EC1V 2NX | Mon-Sat 8 AM-5 PM.

## Product Categories

- [Headstones](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/headstones/): Traditional and modern granite headstones in multiple shapes and colours.
- [Heart Headstones](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/heart-headstones/): Heart-shaped granite memorials, single and double heart designs.
- [Book Headstones](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/book-headstones/): Open and closed book-style memorials, including carved and sandblasted designs.
- [Angel Headstones](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/angel-headstone/): Carved and sculpted angel memorials, including weeping, kneeling and winged designs.
- [Children's Headstones](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/childrens-headstones/): Memorials for children with teddy, bunny, star and heart designs.
- [Bespoke Memorials](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/bespoke/): Fully custom memorials in a wide choice of granites and designs.
- [Kerb Sets](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/kerb-sets/): Full and three-sided kerb sets, including rising-step and European styles.
- [Memorial Benches](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/benches/): Granite memorial benches for cemeteries and memorial gardens.
- [Columbarium](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/columbarium/): Multi-niche granite columbaria and memorial walls for ashes.
- [Plaques](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/plaques/): Granite memorial plaques in square, heart, rose and double-heart shapes.
- [Vases](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/vases/): Granite memorial flower vases in many shapes and colours.
- [Urns](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/urns/): Granite cremation and memorial urns for ashes.
- [Grave Markers](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/memorials/grave-markers/): Small markers including flat, pillow, lawn-level, cross, book-style and heart grave markers.
- [Metal Urns](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/metal-urns/): Metal urns range.
